cues.text: A deserted back alley, graffiti on the walls and trash bags and bins along one side. Nozomi walks in with two young men behind him, and a bitter-looking middle-aged man in a suit and glasses stands waiting by the bins.
Nozomi turns around to find the two men closing in on him. He backs away, arms spread, trembling.
You come running into the alley. Nozomi spots you and stumbles toward you, arms out.
Nozomi is in tears. The two men turn and walk off, and Nozomi scurries over to your side.
The bitter-looking man walks past you and out of the alley, leaving you with Nozomi, who is still crying and wiping his face.
